validation.measured_by: src/nfl/fit_elo.py against the nflverse archive of 2026-10-21; reproducible with `python -m src.nfl.ingest && python -m src.nfl.fit_elo`
validation.note: The held-out scores are what that fit reported, to five decimal places. Fitted on 1999-2020 and scored once on 2021-2025, which the search never saw; the 2026 season was in progress and is neither fitted nor scored. measured_on_elo_sha256 is sha256 of the canonical "elo" block above, so changing a parameter without re-fitting fails the build instead of publishing this claim over it. Both k and offseason_retention were chosen at the edge of the first grid and the grid was widened until they were not; the values here sit inside it.
